scoring_justification: Magnetic moments cannot be recomputed by the verifier; scoring compares self-reported values to paper-reported values with tolerance for legitimate implementation variation.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported total magnetic moments for DFT defect models
hidden_assets.source_provenance: From paper text (Section 3, steps 5-8 and Fig. 6,7): V_In=1.830, Sm_In=5.143, Sm_In+V_In=4.658 muB; pristine and V_S are nonmagnetic.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own computed results used as reference for reproduction accuracy.

outputs.description: Total magnetic moment for each of the five defect supercell models: pristine, V_S, V_In, Sm_In, Sm_In+V_In.

output_contract.notes: Verification compares the reported total magnetic moments against known paper reference values using a tolerance; the scoring uses linear-decay closeness (reference_match style). Only the magnetic moments are scored; band structures and formation energies are not required.
